label: pjm 97 measured interfaces
definition: PJM 97 (PROBE, NOT a keeper candidate — G-20 Phase-2 internal-interface arm): pjm-96 recipe (pjm-94 keeper byte-faithful via replay_keeper.build_kwargs + pjm_seam_measured_ladder) + pjm_measured_interface_limits=True (NEW this session: the measured HOURLY PJM Data Miner 2 transfer limits — transfer-interface-limits clean datatype, rules 13/14 measured-physical — replace the static ttc_mw / pjm_congestion pooled medians on the seven mapped internal links, forward direction, min(pre,post) where both publish; constants.PJM_INTERFACE_LINK_MAP documents the crosswalk and its rule-14 boundary misalignments) + pjm_reserve_pergen + measured_ramp_capability carried per the pjm-81 owner recommendation (deliverable ramp pool 48.2 -> 37.8 GW under the measured intake). HYPOTHESIS (task brief): with the western phantom supply physically capped hourly, Dominion/EMAAC/SWMAAC CC+CT recover toward actuals (C1), CT per-plant capture rises, and the nested MAD reserve family binds in the 2025 heat-wave hours so the C3c tail prices via in-LP reserve duals. RESULT (2026-07-10, all three legs REFUTED): the caps BIND hard — AEP->Dominion runs at its measured hourly limit ~94% of hours (8215/8392/8272 h across 2023/24/25), West_APS->Dominion 7876/3801/2559 h, ComEd->AEP 987/2202/3029 h — yet the eastern under-run does not recover: Dominion CC -78->-81% (2023), -42->-39%, -11->-9%; Dominion CT -90->-91 / -86->-90 / -72->-80%; EMAAC CT -80->-81/-82/-83%; SWMAAC CC -88->-93% (2025). The one clear gain is the ComEd corridor over-run, cut by the measured 50045005 cap (~2,900-3,100 MW vs the 6,000 static): ComEd CT +73->+35% (2024), +111->+85% (2025). CT per-plant capture FELL (2023 median r 0.301->0.246, share r<0.3 50->61%; 2024 0.401->0.381; 2025 0.422->0.409) and the C3c tail is UNCHANGED at 0 h >$200 vs 6/18/59 actual (2024 even loses pjm-94's 4 modeled hours); the per-gen MAD reserve family still never binds. ATTRIBUTION: with channel (b) closed, Dominion becomes a through-corridor — it imports at the measured caps from AEP/West_APS and RE-EXPORTS at cap into SWMAAC 5193-6703 h/yr — and no cut binds around the MAD zones because the Carolinas/TVA/LGEE seam supply (right-sized UPWARD by the measured ladder, per the pjm-96 finding) replaces what the west can no longer push; zonal LMPs barely separate and system net export overshoots (27.1 vs 18.0 TWh actual, 2025). The eastern locals are priced/committed out by seam-plus-west supply even under measured transmission physics, so the remaining root cause is the Phase-1 commitment posture of eastern CC/CT (the pjm-81 attribution) and the seam-inflow structure at Dominion — NOT the internal transmission representation, which is now measured end-to-end. Scorecard: C1 15/16 (free 11/12, vs pjm-94 14/16 free 10/12 — the 2023 CC_REGULAR system cell clears, carried by the seam ladder exactly as in pjm-96), C2 CAVEAT (+3.0% 2025 gas, commercial band), C3a FAIL (-15.6% 2025), C3b FAIL 3-of-3 (NRMSE 0.232/0.219/0.249, statistically the pjm-96 regression — the interface limits neither fix nor materially worsen it), C3c FAIL 0/6, 0/18, 0/59 h, C4/C5a PASS. Determination NOT-YET (governance gate UNATTESTED — rejected probe, no attestation drafted). DISPOSITION: keeper stays 2026-07-09-pjm-94-stgas-netload. Per rule 14 the measured interface limits are the correct physical input and STAY in the codebase as the default-off backcast overlay — the worse CT capture under truer physics is the discovered-bug signal pointing at the offer/commitment layer, and reverting to the static estimates would bury it. Registered per rule 15 (every completed run goes on the dashboard, keeper or rejected probe).
